detail: Review saves setup's policy as a draft so orchd validates it. Cancel then re-saves the applied document, which clears drift, but only when a policy is applied and no other draft was pending; on a first setup, or over a pending (for example agent-saved) draft, the setup draft stays as the newest revision, unapplied, and the pane says so. Proposed: a DiscardSpacesDraft RPC (orchd.proto change), or saving drafts that DiffSpaces can compare without making them the newest revision.
